lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters is visible, arranged in approximately 10-12 vertical columns across the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance spots to create a rectangular grid of anchor nodes along the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of light-reflective dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin exhibits a highly organized spotting pattern, with distinct vertical rows of high-luminance blobs extending through the length of both the upper and lower lobes.
